author: RealGamer69
quote:
Assassin’s Creed Shadows – A TOTAL DISASTER, FOLKS!

Let me tell you, I know games. I’ve played some of the best games, some of the greatest. People come up to me all the time, they say, “Sir, you have incredible taste in games.” And it’s true. I have the best taste. But this? This is an embarrassment. A disgrace to gaming, to history, to the Assassin’s Creed name.

First of all, stealth is gone. Completely gone. You’re sneaking around like a clown at a birthday party, loud, ridiculous, completely obvious. I remember when Assassin’s Creed was about being an assassin. Now? You’re just some guy running around like an idiot, alerting every guard within a five-mile radius. Pathetic.

And don’t get me started on the combat. Oh boy. Clunky, slow, uninspired. I’ve seen better fights in a nursing home. The AI? Dumber than a bag of rocks. You can take out an entire army, and guess what? Nobody reacts. “Oh, he just murdered 12 of our guys? Let’s go back to patrolling like nothing happened.” Sad!

The game runs like an absolute train wreck. I have a top-tier setup, one of the best. People tell me, “Sir, your gaming rig is unbelievable.” And it is. And yet, this game stutters, lags, crashes. It’s almost impressive—I’ve seen PowerPoint presentations with smoother frame rates.

And of course, it’s bloated with pointless filler. Side quests that make no sense, a giant open world that’s completely empty, and let’s not forget—microtransactions! Oh, you wanted a cool outfit? That’ll be $20, thank you very much. These companies think they can fool us, but we’re too smart for that, folks.

Listen, I’ve played some legendary games. I know what greatness looks like. And this? This ain’t it. Assassin’s Creed used to be one of the best franchises ever. Now? It’s a joke. A TOTAL DISGRACE.

FINAL SCORE? 0/10. And that’s me being generous. Very, very generous.
